title: Outer products and projectors
objectives: Distinguish scalar inner products from matrix outer products.
Construct rank-one projectors and separate projection, probability and normalization.
prerequisites: Chapter 2’s vectors, basis labels and matrix multiplication; elementary algebra. New notation is developed in the text.

quizzes.question: Which expression is a matrix?
feedback: An inner product is a scalar.
Correct: an m×1 column times a 1×n row is an m×n matrix.
A norm is a nonnegative scalar.

quizzes.question: A projected measurement branch has squared norm p>0. How do we normalize it?
feedback: That would generally leave squared norm 1/p.
Correct. Its norm, rather than squared norm, is √p.
That shrinks the vector instead of making its norm one.
